evidence_references.statement: At the frozen baseline the resolver read 'sp = split_map.get(self.split, ScenarioSplit.DEV)' so an unrecognised label such as 'validation' resolved to ScenarioSplit.DEV (offset 0).
The fail-open fallback was still present immediately before F-SPLIT-1 and was removed by bd1fcc109.

2394 historical run manifests record split='validation'; all 2394 carry a seed in the 1000-1999 band. Because baseline resolution mapped the label to DEV (offset 0), the absolute seeds those runs actually used are the band values themselves, NOT the +1000 values a VAL resolution would produce. Ground truth was therefore inspectable under DEV semantics.

Run-id split suffixes (_dev/_val/_holdout) exist for 1622 runs, but NONE of the 2394 validation-labelled runs carries such a suffix (legacy format), so run-id alone cannot establish the resolved split for these sites.
